name: io.github.socialitcom/mcp
title: Socialit
description: Schedule social posts, answer DMs and comments, read analytics, run CRM automations and ads.

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALIT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Socialit workspace API key (sk_live_...), from Manage, API keys

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALIT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Only these toolsets, comma-separated, such as posts,media,accounts,analytics

environmentVariables.name: SOCIALIT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: only tools that change nothing

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer and a Socialit API key (Bearer sk_live_...). Without it, clients sign in with OAuth.
